implementation.areaPlans: Eight horizontal area plans per MCU and vertical plans once per MCU row; identical weights/phases/edges.
implementation.forwardTransform: Independently generated mathematical signed16-bit weights and exact SSE2/AVX2 butterflies/dot products, signed high products and widened row reductions. Scalar fallback retained; no upstream tables/source.
implementation.normalization: Bounded20x20 stack RGB tile normalizes each distinct MCU/halo pixel once; no full-frame cache.
implementation.quantization: One512-byte stack reciprocal/rounding plan per operation, shared by both passes; exact integer quantization unchanged.
implementation.resource: All scratch remains inside the existing8-KiB fixed owner, no new owned heap allocation; work262144per subsampled MCU unchanged, same table owners and terminal admission/cancellation/ownership contracts.
